name: Newell-based Visibility Sorting
aliases: Extended Newell, Newell and Sancha sort
definition: An algorithm to sort cells back-to-front for correct hardware compositing, extended from polygon sorting to polyhedra.
summary: Newell-based Visibility Sorting is an O(n²) algorithm that orders convex polyhedra back-to-front for volume rendering by using iterative geometric occlusion tests and list reordering to handle unstructured meshes without topological adjacency.
